questions.question: What should happen to rows with negative amounts?

options.label: Keep, mark as debits
options.adds: Negative amounts are legitimate (debits or refunds), so keep them in the export but handle them consistently and correctly.

options.label: Make them positive
options.adds: Convert negative amounts to positive values in the export.

options.label: Exclude those rows
options.adds: Leave rows with negative amounts out of the export.

options.label: Diagnose first
options.adds: Don't change any code yet; first tell me why negatives appear and what the options are.

oracleAnswers.What should happen to rows with negative: They're refunds, so leave them out of the category totals and report their sum as a positive refunds figure, while the overall total stays net.
